sn11.25:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Savatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anathapiṇḍika’s Park.
sn11.25:1.3: There the Blessed One said this:
sn11.25:1.4: “Bhikkhus, once in the past Sakka, lord of the devas, instructing the Tavatiṁsa devas in the Sudhamma assembly hall, on that occasion recited this verse:
sn11.25:2.2: Do not become angry at those who are angry.
sn11.25:2.4: Within the hearts of the noble ones.
sn11.25:2.5:
Like a mountain avalanche
Anger crushes evil people.’”
sn11.25:4.5: The Book with Verses is finished.
